system.description:
DISCIPLE MYSTIC STANCE

You enter the stance of the mantis targeting your foes with crippling accuracy. Whilst in this stance your unarmed attacks gain the deadly trait. Furthermore, you gain a +2-circumstance bonus to Reflex saves and may take one Move action each turn that does not provoke reactions.

Automated: press Use to enter the stance: 1 AP, under the system's stance rules (one stance at a time, or two with Stance Mastery; Reactive Stance enters it free at initiative). It lasts until you enter another stance or delete its effect. While in it: your unarmed attacks (fists, gauntlets, Monastic weapons) have the Deadly trait; +2 circumstance to Reflex saves; and the first Move action of each of your turns triggers no reactions (Graham's B6-4).
